# Kazzy & Ko Hauling

> Owner-operated junk removal, property cleanouts and light demolition based in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, serving Milwaukee, Waukesha, Racine and Ozaukee Counties. Run by co-owners Ben and Jordan.

- Phone (call or text): (414) 388-6289
- Email: kazzykohauling@gmail.com
- Hours: 6 AM to 9 PM, 7 days a week
- Pricing: by how much of our 14-cubic-yard (16' x 6' x 4') trailer a load fills. $125 minimum (1-2 bulky items), $250 quarter load, $400 half load, $550 three-quarter load, $700 full load. Free estimates from photos; the final price is set on site once items are loaded. Demolition and specialty items (pianos, pool tables, hot tubs, safes, dirt, concrete) are priced separately.
- Every job includes the heavy lifting, donation sorting and a broom sweep. Usable items are donated; metal and appliances are recycled.
- Payment: cash, card or check (3% fee on electronic payments).
